## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link related issues.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Explicitly mark tests that were not run.
Include three-language screenshots when changing the console.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Core/server boundaries and authorization are preserved.
- [ ] `en`, `de` and `fa` catalogs have matching keys/placeholders.
- [ ] English and German documentation reflect the change.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, generated binaries or false readiness claims are included.
- [ ] Migration and compatibility impact are described.
